Native remote c6b762d7-095b-4807-8570-597e55f8e3e4 produced one 288750-byte 832x480/17frame/16FPS mute video, SHA256 ed7794aa838b6d84f34890323fdf1014c258ded6975b56202b470d02c7b669b7. Independent mask admission/review and pre-upload checks; user interface uses Add edit in existing video editor. One cleared fixture, model detail/edge limitations remain.
